Dumping everything in a dish are my favourite dinners for those low energy days. All I had to do pretty much was boil some pasta! 🙌🏼
Recipe serves 2-3 people:
✨Place 2 pieces of Salmon, 1 block of feta, 200g cherry or plum tomatoes, 2 handfuls of spinach, 1 tablespoon pesto, seasoning of choice, drizzle of olive oil into a dish.
✨Cook for 30 minutes on 170c (fan assisted oven)
✨Add 200g cooked pasta and a tablespoon of pasta
water and mix
✨Serve with grated cheese of choice!

What's one job you've been putting off because your brain keeps telling you it'll take ages? 👀
After so many of you asked me to do another one, here's round two of timing the jobs I've been avoiding to see how long they actually take
l've realised my brain is really good at convincing me that certain jobs are going to take forever... so I keep putting them off but this little experiment is definitely helping to retrain my brain!
This week's results:
✨Windows: procrastinated for 5 weeks - actually took 12 minutes 53 seconds
✨Kettle: procrastinated for 3 months - actually took 7 minutes 19 seconds (using my citric acid hack!)
✨Chairs: procrastinated for 3 weeks - actually took 11 minutes and 21 seconds

This week I also realised something else... I kept waiting until I felt motivated to start, but the motivation came once I'd got going!
Now tell me... what's been sitting on your to-do list for weeks (or even months)?

Ib: @christi.newrutzen

#procrastinating #cleaningtips #cleaningmotivation #cleaningaccount #cleantok

My DMs have been busy with requests about this, so here's 4 DIY fly repellent hacks I've found online that are definitely worth trying 🪰✨
1. Fill a saucepan halfway with water, add 1 sliced lemon, 1-2 sprigs of rosemary, 10-20 cloves and 10-20 drops of lemongrass essential oil. Bring to the boil, then simmer.
Top up the water as and when needed - refresh every couple of days when the scent starts to fade.
2. Sprinkle cinnamon around the base and inside the lid of your bins to help deter flies from hanging around those unwanted smells
3. Add cloves to half a lemon and place it in your fruit bowl to help keep fruit flies away
4. Place mint near an open window to help discourage flies from coming in
Which one will you try first?
#cleantok #cleaningtips #cleaningmotivation #cleaningaccount #hometips

Are you guilty of procrastinating too? 👀 What's one job you've been putting off because you think it'll take ages?
I realised I spend far longer thinking about certain jobs than actually doing them.
So I timed some of the tasks I've been avoiding to see how long it really takes and hopefully retrain my brain in the process!
This week's results:
✨Skylight: procrastinated for 5 weeks and time it
actually took was 7 minutes 24 seconds.
✨Sticker removal: procrastinated for 3 months and time it actually took was 5 minutes and 2 seconds.
✨Clearing stairs: procrastinated for 1 week and time it actually took was 1 minute 42 seconds.
Turns out procrastination is often way more time-consuming than the job itself. 

Now tell me... what's been sitting on your to-do list for weeks (or months)?

Try this 10-minute Big Mac taco for those low-energy days 🍔🌮
.
100g mince pressed onto a regular wrap, seasoned with salt & pepper, then cooked mince-side down for around 5 minutes. Flip, add a square of cheese and cook for a further 3 minutes until melted.
Finish with salad, gherkins and burger sauce for the ultimate Big Mac-inspired fakeaway 🙌🏼

The only background noise my brain is accepting from now on 😂

This is one of those jobs I’ve been meaning to do for ages and I’m so glad I finally did.🌿💦 

I’ve wanted a little water feature for a while, but didn’t want to spend a fortune so decided to DIY it. All you need is two planters, bricks (although I thought afterwards I could’ve just filled the whole planter with soil 🤔), a few flowers, white decorative stones and a solar fountain. 

I love how it finishes off this corner of the garden. The sound of the water just adds that little bit of zen. And adding wheels to the base means that I can move it around when I get bored and want a change ✨

#diygarden #diyhomeprojects #diywaterfountain #diyhomedecor #gardendecor

🍋🕯️ DIY Fly & Mosquito Repellent Candle ✨🌿
Keeping the bugs away without ruining the vibe! 💛
Sorry but how gorgeous are these?! You can make them by filling a vase or jar with water, adding sliced lemon and a few drops of lemongrass essential oil, then top it with a floating candle.
As the candle gently warms the surface, it helps release the fresh citrus and lemongrass aroma into the air creating a gorgeous glow while helping to deter flies and mosquitoes.
I also added sliced lime and a few aromatic herbs for extra fragrance and decoration, but these are completely optional. The lemon and lemongrass are the key ingredients.
Perfect for BBQs, garden parties, or those relaxing summer evenings outdoors. ☀️🌿 #hometips #lifehacks #homehacks #summerhacks #hostingideas

20-minute Chicken Gyros Bowl 🌯🥗✨

This one is so easy to throw together and packed with flavour!

🍗 Diced chicken breast coated in the Tesco Gyros Flavour Kit – simply mix the gyros seasoning paste with 50g of yogurt, coat the chicken and air fry at 180°C for 20 minutes.

🍟 While the chicken cooks, make some fries and a fresh salad.

🥙 Once everything’s ready, load it all into a bowl, add a few flatbread quarters (air fried for a couple of minutes until golden), and finish with a generous dollop of tzatziki.

Quick, delicious and perfect for a midweek dinner! 💙
